title: admin.account_recovery_approved
description: AccountRecoveryApproved is published by admin when staff approves a request to recover an account that lost its second factor. Identify reacts by turning two-factor authentication off for that user, invalidating their recovery codes and emailing them. It strips a protection from an account, so identify must check the signature before touching anything. There is no version: a request is resolved only once, and identify applies the event only while the request is still pending, so duplicated deliveries are harmless.

event_id.description: Identificador único del evento. Usar para deduplicar (at-least-once).

occurred_at.description: Momento del hecho de negocio, ISO 8601 en UTC.

request_id.description: Solicitud de recuperación resuelta (ID de discordia-identify).

user_id.description: Usuario dueño de la solicitud (ID de discordia-identify).

signature.description: HMAC-SHA256 en hexadecimal. Ver la sección "Firma" de la descripción del documento.
